I am hiring two doctoral students at the Center for Holistic Learning Experiences (CHLX) of UniDistance in Switzerland. Application deadline: 29th of May.

Position 1: Effortful Learning with Generative AI

Deep human learning typically happens in two steps: First, a moment of difficulty or friction, then a moment of resolution. In contrast, current Generative AI tools typically offer a friction-less experience, thus only supporting superficial learning. In this project, you will explore whether friction can be used as a strong design concept to create effective learning experiences using Generative AI.

🔗

Position 2: Collaborative Embodied Learning in VR

Research in mathematics education has shown that learning happens through translation between concrete (e.g. embodied, visual, interactive, familiar) and abstract (e.g. symbolic, idealized) representations. While these transitions have been thoroughly investigated in single-human settings, you will explore how to design VR learning activities that support collaborative learning using both concrete and abstract representations. Note: Collaboration can happen with humans but also with AI agents.

🔗
